mission.goal: Close important functional gaps from the comprehensive plan and Beads; publish meaningful increments directly to main through GitHub.
scope: FSS-076 through FSS-078: retained event proposal ownership
FSS-139 and FSS-142: native ONNX pooling compatibility

authority.scope: Repository source and deterministic fixtures; no live cameras or notification effects.
authority.publication: Non-force main updates with an expected-parent lease, through the GitHub connector.
authority.release: Local repository qualification and retained DSR evidence remain required.

checkpoints.change: Prepare recorded-luma and detector-package candidates through the immutable retained reader while capture owns the writer.
Import ceil-mode MaxPool through the existing native operator and admit valid partial windows with negative shape numerators.

behavior: Preparation shares one immutable source snapshot, cumulative retained-read allowance and final metadata/custody validation. No proposal text or JSON export is released on failed final checks.

Proposal digests, event bytes, policy semantics and publication authority are unchanged. Publication takes the exclusive writer and independently prepares the candidate again before checking approval.
Read byte/object flags now apply to prepare, remain bounded, and are rejected for publication. The external report keeps its separate existing max-report-bytes bound.
ONNX MaxPool ceil_mode=1 with explicit/absent pads or NOTSET lowers to the existing native Boolean attribute. Omitted and explicit-zero flags keep their former lowering.

Native pooling admits a partial window when padded input is smaller than its kernel by less than one stride, rejects empty spatial inputs, and preserves checked arithmetic and trailing-window suppression.

No operator tables, graph versions, runtime kernels, frozen identities or cost contracts are extended. Dilation, optional index outputs and ceil mode with automatic VALID/SAME padding remain unsupported.

validation.source_review: Independent review of both widened proposal APIs, exact summary compatibility, parser routing, shared read allowances and final validation before exports. Native importer, unsigned output geometry, actual executor test APIs and unchanged frozen schema were also reviewed.
regression_tests_added: Prepare with an active capture writer, exact digest/event parity and later approved publication
No output/export or custody repair for corrupt source, incomplete journals or exhausted read limits
Immutable package preparation preserves an existing publication's exact digest and status
Read-limit parser admission for prepare and rejection for publish
Six MaxPool contracts: hand results, 102 coordinate-oracle cases, graph/artifact identity, actual scalar/optimized budget and cancellation checks, malformed inputs and full-width arithmetic
